name: trash-countdown
title: Trash Countdown
description: Trash list showing time left before each item is purged, highlighting soon-to-go items, with one-tap restore, and an empty-trash confirm that needs the typed item count and resets if new items arrive mid-confirmation.

meta.summary: Shows how long each trashed item has before it's deleted forever, and makes emptying the trash need the typed item count.
meta.server: Run purges server-side on the stated schedule and authorize empty-trash requests; keep restore possible until the purge.
catches: Items close to permanent deletion (within soonDays)
Time left per item, as text and a bar
Recently trashed items, called out before emptying
New items arriving during the empty confirmation, which resets it
limits: Purge timing comes from retentionDays you pass; the server's purge job decides
Typing the count proves attention, not authorization
a11y: Section labelled by its title; empty toggle uses aria-expanded/aria-controls
Confirm area is inert until opened; focus moves to the count input; Escape cancels
Count input has a <label> and is described by the grew-meanwhile note
